coverage.formula: count of unique (floor(x_m/0.5), floor(y_m/0.5)) trajectory cells
coverage.inclusion: all trajectory rows while the Scout is active

outcome_funnel.inclusion: valid event sequence; colony mission outcome is separate

return_progress.formula: start/minimum/final Euclidean distance to the Scout home pose

nest_energy.formula: cumulative delivered_energy; target is reached when energy >= target

revisit.formula: trajectory samples whose canonical 0.5 m cell was previously observed by that Scout

repeated_decision.formula: consecutive equal action labels within the same canonical 0.5 m cell

local_cycle_episode.formula: maximal >=30 s interval with revisits and net displacement <=0.5 m
